title: bump_version and create_candidate_tag hardcoded to src/moeb/Cargo.toml; fail on all non-moeb project runs
description:
bump_version returns 'could not read src/moeb/Cargo.toml: The system cannot find the path specified' when invoked during a run in any project other than moeb itself. Both tools are hardcoded to the moeb binary's own Cargo.toml path. create_candidate_tag has the same dependency and is also skipped whenever bump_version fails. This makes Phase 9 of run.skill.md (version bump + candidate tag) non-functional for every project that relies on moeb to manage its own versioning — the two tools that close the run phase always fail unless the run is operating on moeb's own source tree.

First observed during Ariadne runs (de54ae27-b400-4030-9554-4ba917dcbd3a and ed4db31a-ae77-4d84-8896-cc20d148d3e9). The same failure will occur for any client project. The issue is latent for all existing moeb consumers.

Forwarded from Ariadne signal 9c0e1f2a-3b4d-4c5e-9f0a-1b2c3d4e5f6a.
proposed_resolution: Add an optional cargo_toml_path parameter to bump_version (default: 'src/moeb/Cargo.toml' for backwards compatibility with moeb's own runs). When provided, use the specified path instead of the hardcoded one. Apply the same optional parameter to create_candidate_tag. In run.skill.md, when operating on a non-moeb project, resolve cargo_toml_path from .moeb/config (add a versioned_artifact_path config key) or infer it by probing: project root Cargo.toml → src/Cargo.toml → src/<project_name>/Cargo.toml. If the project is not a Rust project, allow bump_version to operate on a generic version file (package.json version field, pyproject.toml [tool.poetry].version, or a VERSION file) with the file path passed as the parameter — the tool should detect the file type from the extension and apply the appropriate version bump strategy.
